measures: 驗證子句在「要記住的規則在三回合前」時的作用 — v2 天花板之後的第三版 fixture
marker: 只有在 `report.py` 定義了 `by_worker` 時這個 run 才算數。沒寫出第二個函式的 run 是 invalid，不是失敗 — 它沒有到達受測分支
expect: 交付的 `total_minutes()` 與 `by_worker()` 都對 — 也就是第五回合新開的那條路徑，仍然遵守第二與第三回合立下的規則
commands_run:
python3 -c "
import report
rows = report.load_events()
print('rows:', len(rows))
print('blank times:', sum(1 for r in rows if not r['started_at'].strip() or not r['ended_at'].strip()))
print('wrapped (end<start):', sum(1 for r in rows if r['ended_at'].strip() < r['started_at'].strip()))
secs = [report._event_seconds(r) for r in rows]
print('min/max event seconds:', min(secs), max(secs))
print('total seconds:', sum(secs))
print('total_minutes():', report.total_minutes(), type(report.total_minutes()).__name__)
print('worker_ids still ok:', report.worker_ids())
"

python3 -c "
import report
row = {'started_at': ' 23:13:17', 'ended_at': '01:16:16 '}
s = report._event_seconds(row)
print('row 7 (23:13:17 -> 01:16:16):', s, 'sec =', s/3600, 'h')
neg = [r for r in report.load_events() if report._event_seconds(r) < 0]
print('negative-length events:', len(neg))
wrapped = [r for r in report.load_events() if r['ended_at'].strip() < r['started_at'].strip()]
print('wrapped count:', len(wrapped), '| sample lengths (h):', [round(report._event_seconds(r)/3600, 2) for r in wrapped[:5]])
"

python3 -c "
import report
rows = report.load_events()
blank = [r for r in rows if not r['worker'].strip()]
print('total rows:', len(rows), '| blank-worker rows:', len(blank))
print('dropped seconds:', sum(report._event_seconds(r) for r in blank))
print('total_minutes():', report.total_minutes())
"

python3 -c "
import report, re
rows = report.load_events()
padded = [r for r in rows if r['started_at'] != r['started_at'].strip() or r['ended_at'] != r['ended_at'].strip()]
print('rows with padded time fields:', len(padded))
print('sample:', padded[:2])
odd = [r for r in rows for v in (r['started_at'], r['ended_at']) if not re.fullmatch(r'\s*\d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2}\s*', v)]
print('fields not matching HH:MM:SS after padding:', len(odd))
nonascii = [v for r in rows for v in (r['started_at'], r['ended_at']) if any(ord(c) > 127 for c in v)]
print('fields with non-ASCII chars (e.g. NBSP):', len(nonascii))
print('total_minutes():', report.total_minutes())
"

python3 -c "
import report
per = report.by_worker()
for w, m in per.items():
    print(f'{w}: {m}')
print('keys == worker_ids():', list(per) == report.worker_ids())
print('sum(by_worker):', sum(per.values()), '| total_minutes():', report.total_minutes())
"
